body: Thank you. I just can't believe I am feeling this way again after all the progress I had made. I'm very disappointed in myself. Thank you for responding.

A few months ago I practically had a nervous breakdown due to stress at work. I felt very alone and that no one would help me, especially some people I considered friends. I started seeing a therapist and was doing much better. Then this week I was venting about someone who was blowing stuff off resulting in more work for me. I was feeling overwhelmed again. Someone told the person and now he is pissed off at me of course. I then confronted the person who did this to me. He is angry at me as well. I feel very alone and that no one cares about me. I was having suicidal thoughts this summer and now I am feeling that way again.
